name: Legume pre-crop credit to the next non-legume crop
how_it_is_used: Credit points when a legume is followed by a non-legume; scaled by legume species, receiving crop and input level (R03). Points are a ranking heuristic, not a yield forecast.
caveats: About one trial in four showed no gain or a loss; gain is smaller with heavy nitrogen use; species differ (soybean and groundnut stronger than cowpea; maize stronger than millet and sorghum).

name: Input-level modifier on legume credit (minimal 1.2, moderate 0.8, high 0.6, unknown 1.0)
caveats: Direction is sourced (benefit shrinks as nitrogen use rises); the numeric multipliers are this tool's assumption.

name: Same crop twice in a row (not allowed, except irrigated wetland rice)
how_it_is_used: Hard exclusion; for irrigated wetland rice a penalty applies instead. Penalty is 10 for soybean, 5 for maize and 8 otherwise.
caveats: Penalty sizes come from US Midwest trials (continuous maize about 4%, continuous soybean about 10%); other crops and regions are assumed.

name: Same botanical family in the previous season
how_it_is_used: Penalty points for shared pests and diseases.
caveats: Needs a citation per family; cereal after cereal is common and often acceptable.

name: Same botanical family two seasons back
Legume directly after a different legume
how_it_is_used: Penalty; legumes can share root diseases and nematodes.

name: Soil pH and texture adjustments from farmer answers
how_it_is_used: Only the difference between the farmer's answer and the satellite soil value moves the score, because the suitability layer already used satellite soil.
caveats: Optimum ranges and texture preferences are starter values pending EcoCrop/agronomist review.

name: Rain-fed season fit: effective rain in the growing window divided by crop water need (>=0.8 good, 0.5-0.8 marginal, <0.5 poor)
how_it_is_used: Excludes or penalises crops whose growing window is too dry; effective rain taken as 75% of total.
caveats: Uses monthly rainfall; dry-spell timing within a month is not captured.

name: Waterlogging: weeks of standing water allows only crops tolerant of it; a few days penalises sensitive crops; wetland rice needs standing water or reliable irrigation
Crop the farmer already grows on this field: score not below 60
how_it_is_used: Applied before the suitability floor, only if no hard rule (water, temperature, season length) excludes the crop.
caveats: Guards against regional data under-rating an area; a crop grown badly would still be lifted.

name: Temperature: mean temperature over the growing window inside the crop limits (outside absolute limits excludes; outside optimum loses 4 points per degree C, max 20)
how_it_is_used: Uses NASA POWER monthly temperature at the location.
caveats: Limits are starter values pending EcoCrop/agronomist review; frost and heat spikes within a month are not captured.

name: Plan repeats a crop within its three seasons
how_it_is_used: Small penalty so options with three different crops are preferred.
caveats: Two-crop alternation (e.g. legume-cereal) is still valid and often common practice.
